SELECT a.domain_id, a.domain, a.sip_ip, a.sip_port, a.`status`, CASE WHEN a.STATUS = 1 AND a.heart_time IS NOT NULL AND a.heart_cycle IS NOT NULL AND a.heart_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL (3 * a.heart_cycle) SECOND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END online, b.`name` areaName, c.`name` industryName FROM GB_SERVER a LEFT JOIN C_AREA_CODE b ON b.`code` = CONCAT(LEFT(a.domain_id, 8), '0000') LEFT JOIN GMV_ENUM_CODE c ON c.parent_id = '1001' AND c.value_start = SUBSTRING(a.domain_id, 9, 2)
and b.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{areaName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and c.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{industryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
order by a.domain_id desc
select a.status deviceStatus, b.status serverStatus, b.http_source httpSource from GMV_OAUTH a inner join GB_SERVER b on a.domain_id = b.domain_id where a.DEL = 0 and a.DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId}
